summary: The flow reads an attacker-controlled integer via request.getParameter in the 68a entry point, stores it in the static `data` field, and the 68b sink performs `data++` with no range check. When `data` is Integer.MAX_VALUE the post-increment silently wraps to Integer.MIN_VALUE (CWE-190). I guard the increment in the sink so it only occurs when it will not overflow, preserving correct behavior for every other input and still computing/printing the result.
